learning_objective: 🎯 Learn the traffic signals of grammar to make your sentences clear, easy to read, and full of emotion!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We always use a Capital Letter to start a brand new sentence. We also use them for Proper Nouns like names of people, cities, days of the week, and the word 'I'!
Every sentence needs a strong ending! We use a Full Stop (.) to end a telling sentence, and a Question Mark (?) when we are asking something.
A comma (,) is a tiny mark that tells the reader to take a short pause. We also use it to separate things in a list, like 'I bought apples, bananas, and grapes.'

fun_activity.title: 🚦 The Punctuation Fixer
fun_activity.instructions: Write this messy sentence on a paper: 'my friend ravi loves playing cricket football and tennis'. Now fix it by adding capital letters, commas, and a full stop!

quick_recap: ⭐ Capital letters are used for the first word of a sentence and special names.
⭐ Full stops, question marks, and exclamation marks show us where to stop.
⭐ Commas give us a tiny pause and help organize long lists of things!
